PreviewReady: Preview ready (not saved). Drag the frames to adjust.
ErrorBusy: The scanner is busy. Try again in a moment.
ErrorOffline: The scanner does not respond. Is it turned on?
ErrorWarmingUp: The scanner is warming up. Try again in a moment.
ServerMode: Share my scanners on the home network
ServerModeHint: OmniScan starts with Windows and stays as an icon in the notification area, so other computers can scan.
PageUnchanged: The page was not changed. Scanning stopped.
SavePdfPromptFormat: Save the PDF of {0} pages before closing?
AssistLooking: Checking the turn and the caption…
ServerNoScanner: No scanner is attached to this computer, so there is nothing to share.
AssistUnknownKey: This does not look like a key of a supported service.
AssistBadKey: The service did not accept the key.
AssistNoModel: The key works, but no model that understands images is available with it.
AssistUnavailable: The service cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
AssistBadAnswer: The service gave an unexpected answer. Try again later.
AssistKeyHint: Keys from OpenAI, Google AI Studio, Anthropic, xAI, OpenRouter and DeepSeek work. The key is stored encrypted and only this Windows user can read it.
AssistWarning: Reduced copies of the scans are sent to {0}, only for what is checked below. Do not turn this on for scans that strangers must not see.
AssistGoogleNotice: With a free key, Google may use what is sent to improve its models.
AssistOpenRouterNotice: OpenRouter passes requests on to models of other companies.
AssistDeepSeekNotice: DeepSeek is run from China, and its terms allow using what is sent to improve the service.
AssistDescribeHint: A short line for each photo and PDF, with words to find it by ("Mass ID", "electric bill"): in descript.ion (Total Commander, Far), in the photo's properties and in the PDF's title. For a PDF its first page is sent.
ViewerHint: Wheel: zoom · drag: move · ← →: previous, next · double-click or Enter: open in another program · Esc: close
ScannerTop: Top of the page on this scanner
ScannerTopHint: If scans come out upside down, choose the other picture.
DocumentHintDetail: Documents are usually kept as PDF. The sheet will be scanned as the first page; more pages can follow.
DocumentHintSavedFormat: It was saved as {0}. It can be redone as the first page of a PDF without scanning again; the image file is removed.
JpegQualityHint: For JPEG files and photos inside PDF. Lower makes smaller files, higher keeps more detail.
